snippet.title: Cole Hunter: Payback - A Space Rogue Odyssey · Demo Trailer · Demo Available on Steam
snippet.description:
*Cole Hunter: Payback* is a retro-inspired 2D bullet hell roguelite where you pilot a customizable ship, scavenge enemy cores to upgrade your arsenal, and chase bounties across a high-stakes space rogue odyssey.

🚀 *Wishlist on Steam:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086070/Cole_Hunter_Payback/
🚀 *Wishlist on Epic Games Store:* https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cole-hunter-payback-27058a
🛰️ *Join the Discord crew:* https://discord.gg/ubfH6bbt27
